activation.ponytail: Both published Ponytail runs, r2 and r3, had full hook-and-skill activation.
activation.rtk: Codex CLI 0.144.1 on Windows did not expand RTK's generated absolute @ reference. The exact upstream rtk-awareness.md body was therefore placed directly in each isolated AGENTS.md.
activation.caveman: Both runs installed all 20 skills found by Caveman's documented Codex installation command into separate isolated CODEX_HOME directories. To keep the eza task prompt byte-identical while guaranteeing treatment activation, the exact upstream caveman/SKILL.md body was also placed in each isolated global AGENTS.md. Rollout session context records the isolated skill catalog and global instructions.
activation.audit_scope: Activation was established from immutable isolated session context and complete behavior logs. The Caveman audit uses one persisted-context verdict for each of its 114 model rounds; it does not claim proxy input compression, which upstream documents as metering-only for Codex ChatGPT logins.

selection.rule: Ponytail r1 was excluded because it was skill-only. RTK r1 was then excluded by replicate index, not outcome, so those arms use r2/r3. Caveman was run twice after the arm was frozen, so both formal runs are published as r1/r2. Every plugin arm has n=2.

provenance.plugin_observations: Ponytail r2/r3 and RTK r2/r3 were sanitized from four isolated local runs under raw/plugin-eza-ab-20260715. Caveman r1/r2 were sanitized from two isolated local runs under raw/plugin-eza-caveman-20260815. Credentials, CODEX_HOME state, absolute local paths, workspaces, binaries, and duplicate logs are excluded.
provenance.matched_baselines: Previously published eza runs under results/rewrite/report-20260714-codex-cli-0.144.1-gpt56-sol-high, restricted to the same task, model, reasoning level, and Codex CLI version.
provenance.round_audit: Sanitized per-round token-count and activation verdicts for the six published plugin runs only.
